definitions.ask: How should blocks recorded under older scanner rules be re-evaluated after the rules change?
definitions.why: A scanner-hit block is a verdict on (bytes, rules); new rules should re-decide it

choices.label: The next publish attempt rescans under current rules and supersedes clean blocks
Stale blocks stay enforced until a human runs a new report-first revalidate command

definitions.ask: Which scanner rules should get the left word-boundary fix?
definitions.why: The Stripe, Slack, GitHub, and Anthropic rules share the same unanchored-prefix defect

choices.label: Every prefix-literal token rule, plus a digit-or-capital body check for sk- keys
Only openai-key, as the research proposed; sibling rules still match inside words

definitions.ask: How should the job report a request that publication protection newly parks?
definitions.why: A real secret in an agent transcript deserves one digest entry, not zero or one per pass

choices.label: The pass that first parks a request reports one error; later rechecks stay silent
Never a job error; parked rows appear only in doctor and the publisher heartbeat

definitions.ask: Should the 233 bob-cli rows quarantined by the .land prompt-archive bug be revived?
definitions.why: Reviving mostly re-publishes identical pages; the fix is proven by new .land rows

choices.label: They stay quarantined; most of their pages were pushed before the ack check refused
The verify phase gates a bounded revival of only those rows to prove the fix

definitions.ask: Should planner prompt-archive rows also append a doorbell hint, as the research proposed?
definitions.why: The unified drain loop reaches hint-less rows in the same pass; a hint only reorders them
